# ng-mapcn — full reference

> Angular port of [mapcn](https://www.mapcn.dev) — composable MapLibre GL v6 map components in the spirit of shadcn/ui. Standalone, signals-first, OnPush, SSR-safe, theme-aware. Carto basemaps by default, so no API key is required. Distributed both as an npm package and as copy-paste sources via `ng add` (you own the code).

Version: 22.0.0-beta.8 · License: MIT · Docs: https://ng-mapcn.vercel.app · Repository: https://github.com/juanvieiraprado99/ng-mapcn

## Installation

### Copy-paste (recommended, shadcn-style)

```bash
ng add ng-mapcn
```

Adds `maplibre-gl`, registers its CSS, appends the required `.maplibregl-popup-*` overrides and copies the component sources into `src/app/components/ui/map` (customize with `--path`). `ng add` installs with the workspace's package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn or bun).

### npm package

```bash
npm install ng-mapcn maplibre-gl
# or: pnpm add / yarn add / bun add ng-mapcn maplibre-gl
```

```scss
// global styles.scss
@use 'ng-mapcn/src/lib/styles/index' as *;  // tokens + utilities
@use 'ng-mapcn/styles.scss' as *;           // required popup overrides
@import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css'; // MapLibre base CSS
```

The `.maplibregl-popup-*` overrides are **required** — MapLibre injects its own popup chrome, which must be neutralized for popups and tooltips to render correctly.

### Agent skill

```bash
npx skills add juanvieiraprado99/ng-mapcn
```

Installs the ng-mapcn agent skill (https://github.com/juanvieiraprado99/ng-mapcn/tree/main/skills/ng-mapcn) with the [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) CLI, so coding agents use the real API: selectors, inputs, outputs, setup, recipes and troubleshooting.

## Quick start

```html
<ng-map [center]="[-46.63, -23.55]" [zoom]="10">
  <ng-map-controls position="bottom-right" [showZoom]="true" [showCompass]="true" />

  <ng-map-marker [longitude]="-46.63" [latitude]="-23.55" [draggable]="true">
    <ng-marker-content><!-- empty = default blue dot --></ng-marker-content>
    <ng-marker-popup><strong>São Paulo</strong></ng-marker-popup>
    <ng-marker-tooltip>Olá!</ng-marker-tooltip>
  </ng-map-marker>

  <ng-map-route [coordinates]="lineCoords" color="#4285F4" [width]="3" />
</ng-map>
```

## Component anatomy

Every part of the component set, and how they nest:

```html
<ng-map [center]="[-74.006, 40.7128]" [zoom]="11">
  <ng-map-controls />

  <ng-map-marker [longitude]="-74.006" [latitude]="40.7128">
    <ng-marker-content>
      <div class="size-4 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></div>
      <ng-marker-label position="top">New York</ng-marker-label>
    </ng-marker-content>
    <ng-marker-tooltip>Hover content</ng-marker-tooltip>
    <ng-marker-popup>Click content</ng-marker-popup>
  </ng-map-marker>

  <ng-map-popup [longitude]="-74" [latitude]="40.7">Standalone popup</ng-map-popup>
  <ng-map-route [coordinates]="coordinates" />
  <ng-map-arc [data]="arcs" />
  <ng-map-geojson [data]="geojson" />
  <ng-map-cluster-layer [data]="points" />
  <ng-map-heatmap [data]="points" weightProperty="mag" />
  <ng-map-symbol-layer [data]="points" textField="{name}" />
  <ng-map-raster-source id="radar" [tiles]="radarTiles" [opacity]="0.7" />
  <ng-map-vector-source id="parcels" url="pmtiles://https://example.com/parcels.pmtiles" />
  <ng-map-image-overlay [url]="imageUrl" [coordinates]="corners" />
</ng-map>
```

## Components

### Map

`ng-map`

The root container component that initializes MapLibre GL and provides context to child components. Automatically handles theme switching between light and dark modes.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | `[number, number]` | `[0, 0]` | Initial center coordinates as [longitude, latitude]. |
| `zoom` | `number` | `2` | Initial zoom level of the map. |
| `styles` | `MapStylesConfig` | `CARTO` | Custom style URLs or style objects for light and dark themes. |
| `blank` | `boolean` | `false` | Swaps the basemap for a transparent, tile-less canvas. Add your own layers on top. |
| `projection` | `ProjectionSpecification` | — | Map projection, e.g. { type: 'globe' }. |
| `theme` | `'light' \| 'dark' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Force a theme, or 'auto' to follow the dark/light class on <html>. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the loading overlay. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (loading), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `viewport` | `Partial<MapViewport>` | — | Controlled viewport ({ center, zoom, bearing, pitch }). Pair with viewportChange. |
| `fitBounds` | `MapFitBoundsOptions` | — | Fits the camera to bounds ({ bounds?, padding?, maxZoom?, duration?, animate? }). Without bounds it fits the union of the children's data (markers, GeoJSON, routes, arcs, clusters, heatmaps). Runs after load and refits only when the bounds change; the first fit never animates; maxZoom defaults to 16. A draggable marker bound to signals refits while dragged: pass explicit bounds for that case. Imperative form: MapContextService.fitBounds(). |
| `options` | `Omit<MapOptions, 'container' \| 'style'>` | — | Extra MapLibre MapOptions (scrollZoom, dragRotate, …) passed to the map constructor. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `viewportChange` | `MapViewport` | — | Emits on every viewport change (move, zoom, rotate, pitch). |
| `mapReady` | `Map` | — | Emits the raw maplibre-gl Map instance once loaded. |
| `mapClick` | `MapMouseEvent` | — | Emits when the map is clicked. |
| `mapError` | `Error` | — | Emits when the map fails to initialize or load. |

### MapControls

`ng-map-controls`

Renders map control buttons: zoom, compass, locate, and fullscreen. Mounted inside MapLibre's corner containers, so it stacks with the scale, legend and style switcher; style it with className. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `'top-left' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-right'` | `'bottom-right'` | Corner of the map to place the controls in. |
| `showZoom` | `boolean` | `true` | Show zoom in/out buttons. |
| `showCompass` | `boolean` | `false` | Show compass button (resets bearing). |
| `showLocate` | `boolean` | `false` | Show geolocate button. |
| `showFullscreen` | `boolean` | `false` | Show fullscreen toggle button. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (zoomIn, zoomOut, resetNorth, locate, fullscreen), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-controls element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `locateChange` | `{ longitude: number; latitude: number }` | — | Emits the user position after a successful locate. |
| `locateError` | `GeolocationPositionError \| Error` | — | Emits when locating fails (denied, timeout) or when the browser has no geolocation. |

### MapScale

`ng-map-scale`

A scale bar mounted as a MapLibre control in a corner of the map. It updates while the map moves or zooms, rounds to a 1/2/5 length and formats the value with Intl for the app locale. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | `'metric' \| 'imperial' \| 'both'` | `'metric'` | Unit system of the bar. 'both' draws a metric and an imperial bar. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | `100` | Longest bar length in pixels. |
| `position` | `'top-left' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-right'` | `'bottom-left'` | Corner of the map to place the scale in. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (scale), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-scale element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

### MapLegend

`ng-map-legend`

A legend card mounted as a MapLibre control. Describes data with category swatches and colour gradients; projected content renders below the sections. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sections` | `MapLegendSection[]` | `[]` | Legend sections: { type: 'categories', title?, entries: { color, label, shape?: 'circle' \| 'square' \| 'line' }[] } or { type: 'gradient', title?, stops: { color, value }[], format?: (value) => string }. Gradients always label the first and last stop; middle stops are hidden when they would overlap a neighbour. |
| `title` | `string` | — | Heading of the legend; also its accessible name. |
| `position` | `'top-left' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-right'` | `'top-left'` | Corner of the map to place the legend in. |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a header button that hides the legend body; its accessible name is the heading followed by the show/hide label (e.g. "Places, Hide legend"). |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the body is hidden. A model(): supports two-way binding with [(collapsed)]. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (legend, showLegend, hideLegend), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-legend element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collapsedChange` | `boolean` | — | Emits when the legend is collapsed or expanded (the model output of collapsed). |

### MapStyleSwitcher

`ng-map-style-switcher`

A listbox in a map corner that switches the basemap between the given options. The selected option overrides provideMapStyles() and the map's [styles] for that map; with no value the map keeps its own style. Keep each option's styles object referentially stable: an inline object literal is a new style every render and re-runs setStyle. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `MapStyleOption[]` | `required` | Choices: { id: string; label: string; styles: MapStylesConfig }. Keep the array and each styles object referentially stable (declare them once, not inline in the template). |
| `value` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Id of the selected option. A model(): supports [(value)]. undefined leaves the map's own style untouched. |
| `position` | `'top-left' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-right'` | `'top-right'` | Corner of the map to place the switcher in. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (mapStyle), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-style-switcher element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valueChange` | `string \| undefined` | — | Emits the selected option id (the model output of value). |

### MapMarker

`ng-map-marker`

A container for marker-related components. Provides context for its children and handles marker positioning.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `longitude` | `number` | `required` | Longitude coordinate of the marker. |
| `latitude` | `number` | `required` | Latitude coordinate of the marker. |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows the marker to be dragged. |
| `offset` | `PointLike` | — | Pixel offset applied to the marker element. |
| `rotation` | `number` | `0` | Rotation of the marker in degrees. |
| `anchor` | `PositionAnchor` | — | Part of the marker element positioned at the coordinates. |
| `rotationAlignment` | `'map' \| 'viewport' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | How the marker rotates with the map. |
| `pitchAlignment` | `'map' \| 'viewport' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | How the marker tilts with the map pitch. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the marker (aria-label). Interactive markers whose content has no text fall back to labels.marker ('Map marker'); a static labelled marker gets role="img". |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (marker), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `keyboardStep` | `number` | `10` | Pixels a draggable marker moves per arrow key press. |
| `keyboardStepLarge` | `number` | `50` | Pixels per arrow key press while Shift is held. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `markerClick` | `MouseEvent` | — | Emits when the marker is clicked, or when Enter or Space (on keyup) is pressed on the focused marker, also with ng-marker-popup. Give icon-only clickable markers their own ariaLabel. A marker with this handler becomes a role=button tab stop. |
| `markerMouseEnter` | `MouseEvent` | — | Emits when the pointer enters the marker. |
| `markerMouseLeave` | `MouseEvent` | — | Emits when the pointer leaves the marker. |
| `dragStart` | `{ lng: number; lat: number }` | — | Emits when dragging starts. |
| `drag` | `{ lng: number; lat: number }` | — | Emits continuously while dragging. |
| `dragEnd` | `{ lng: number; lat: number }` | — | Emits the final position after dragging. |

### MarkerContent

`ng-marker-content`

Renders the visual content of a marker via content projection. If left empty, a default blue dot is rendered; it follows conditional content (shown while nothing is projected). Must be used inside ng-map-marker.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-marker-content element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

### MarkerLabel

`ng-marker-label`

An always-visible text label above or below the marker. Must be used inside ng-marker-content.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | `'top'` | Side of the marker the label appears on. |

### MarkerPopup

`ng-marker-popup`

A popup attached to the marker that opens on click. Must be used inside ng-map-marker. Keyboard: the marker becomes a focusable role=button with aria-haspopup=dialog (unless you set them), Enter/Space opens it, focus moves into the popup, and Escape closes it, stops propagation and returns focus to the marker. Avoid your own <button> inside ng-marker-content (nested interactive content).

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `closeButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a close button in the popup. |
| `offset` | `Offset` | — | Pixel offset from the marker. Reconciled live via setOffset; MapLibre's default when unset. |
| `anchor` | `PositionAnchor` | — | Which side of the marker the popup anchors to. Applied at creation only. |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `'none'` | CSS max-width of the popup container. Reconciled live via setMaxWidth. |
| `closeOnClick` | `boolean` | `false` | Closes the popup when the map is clicked. Applied at creation only. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (closePopup), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-popup-card element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `popupClose` | `void` | — | Emits when the popup closes. |

### MarkerTooltip

`ng-marker-tooltip`

A tooltip that appears on marker hover and keyboard focus (Escape or blur closes it; the marker becomes a tab stop). Must be used inside ng-map-marker.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | `Offset` | `16` | Pixel distance between the marker and the tooltip. |
| `anchor` | `PositionAnchor` | — | Which side of the coordinates the tooltip anchors to. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-tooltip-pill element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. |

### MapPopup

`ng-map-popup`

A standalone popup component that can be placed anywhere on the map without a marker. Must be used inside ng-map. Keyboard: focus moves into the popup when it opens, and Escape inside it closes it (stops propagation, so a host dialog stays open).

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `longitude` | `number` | `required` | Longitude coordinate of the popup. |
| `latitude` | `number` | `required` | Latitude coordinate of the popup. |
| `closeButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a close button in the popup. |
| `offset` | `Offset` | `16` | Pixel offset of the popup. |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `'none'` | CSS max-width of the popup container. |
| `closeOnClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Closes the popup when the map is clicked. Applied at creation only. Set false for popups that follow the hover. |
| `labels` | `Partial<MapLabels>` | — | Label overrides (closePopup), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-popup-card element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. Pass ng-popup-passthrough to make the whole popup non-interactive (pointer-events: none), so a hover popup does not capture the cursor and close itself. |
| `open` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the popup is shown. Two-way bindable with [(open)]: closing it writes false, setting true opens it again at the current position. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `popupClose` | `void` | — | Emits when the popup closes, by the user or by setting open to false. |
| `openChange` | `boolean` | — | Emits the new open state (the [(open)] binding). |

### MapRoute

`ng-map-route`

Renders a line/route from the given coordinates. Must be used inside ng-map. Supports click and hover interactions, an active (highlighted) state and a covered-progress line via child ng-route-progress / ng-route-marker components.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinates` | `[number, number][]` | `required` | Array of [longitude, latitude] points forming the line. |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer. |
| `color` | `string` | `'#4285F4'` | Line color. |
| `width` | `number` | `3` | Line width in pixels. |
| `opacity` | `number` | `0.8` | Line opacity. |
| `dashArray` | `number[]` | — | Dash pattern, e.g. [2, 2]. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables pointer events on the line. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Id of an existing layer to insert the route (and its progress line) below. Applied at creation only. |
| `progress` | `number` | — | Covered fraction of the route (0 to 1). Drawn by a child ng-route-progress and followed by ng-route-marker at="progress". |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Highlights the route: the active* inputs override the base paint while true. |
| `activeColor` | `string` | — | Line color while active. Falls back to color. |
| `activeWidth` | `number` | — | Line width while active. Falls back to width. |
| `activeOpacity` | `number` | — | Line opacity while active. Falls back to opacity. |
| `activeDashArray` | `number[]` | — | Dash pattern while active. Falls back to dashArray. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeClick` | `MapMouseEvent` | — | Emits when the route is clicked. |
| `routeMouseEnter` | `MapMouseEvent` | — | Emits when the pointer enters the route (the cursor becomes a pointer). |
| `routeMouseLeave` | `MapMouseEvent` | — | Emits when the pointer leaves the route. |

### RouteProgress

`ng-route-progress`

Draws the covered part of the parent ng-map-route, as set by its progress input (computed by cumulative distance along the line). Use inside ng-map-route.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `string` | `'#22c55e'` | Color of the covered line. |
| `width` | `number` | `route width` | Width of the covered line in pixels. |
| `opacity` | `number` | `1` | Opacity of the covered line. |
| `dashArray` | `number[]` | — | Dash pattern of the covered line. |

### RouteMarker

`ng-route-marker`

A marker placed along the parent ng-map-route. Project ng-marker-content (and label, popup, tooltip) into it. Created once and moved as progress or coordinates change.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'progress' \| number` | `'start'` | Position on the route: its start, end, the current progress, or a fraction between 0 and 1 of the total distance. |

### MapArc

`ng-map-arc`

Renders curved lines between coordinate pairs using quadratic Bézier interpolation, with longitude unwrapping across the antimeridian. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `MapArcDatum[]` | `required` | Arcs to draw: { id, from: [lng, lat], to: [lng, lat] }. Extra properties are exposed to paint expressions. |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer. |
| `curvature` | `number` | `0.2` | How much the arc bends. |
| `samples` | `number` | `64` | Number of interpolation points per arc. |
| `paint` | `LineLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | MapLibre line paint properties. |
| `layout` | `LineLayerSpecification["layout"]` | — | MapLibre line layout properties. |
| `hoverPaint` | `LineLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Paint overrides applied to the hovered arc via feature-state. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables pointer events (adds an invisible hit layer). |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arcClick` | `MapArcEvent` | — | Emits { arc, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } when an arc is clicked. |
| `arcHover` | `MapArcEvent \| null` | — | Emits on hover; null when the pointer leaves. |

### MapGeoJSON

`ng-map-geojson`

Renders GeoJSON polygons and lines with theme-aware monochrome defaults and declarative feature-state hover. Accepts a URL or an inline GeoJSON object. Generic over the feature properties: MapGeoJSONComponent<P>, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `MapGeoJSONData<P>` | `required` | GeoJSON object or URL string. P types the featureClick/featureHover payloads. |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer. |
| `promoteId` | `string` | — | Feature property used as feature id — required for hover feature-state. |
| `fillPaint` | `FillLayerSpecification["paint"]` | `theme mono` | Fill paint properties. |
| `linePaint` | `LineLayerSpecification["paint"]` | `theme mono` | Outline paint properties. |
| `fillHoverPaint` | `FillLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Fill paint overrides applied to the hovered feature. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Enables pointer events and hover tracking. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layers before this layer id. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `featureClick` | `MapGeoJSONEvent<P>` | — | Emits { feature, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } on click. |
| `featureHover` | `MapGeoJSONEvent<P> \| null` | — | Emits on hover; null when the pointer leaves. |

### MapClusterLayer

`ng-map-cluster-layer`

Renders clustered points with MapLibre GL native clustering. Automatically styles cluster circles by point count, zooms in on cluster click. Generic over the feature properties: MapClusterLayerComponent<P>, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `string \| FeatureCollection<Point, P>` | `required` | GeoJSON points (object or URL string). P types the pointClick payload. |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id prefix for the source and layers: cluster-source-<id>, clusters-<id>, cluster-count-<id>, unclustered-point-<id>. Changing it re-creates them. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the cluster layers before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `clusterMaxZoom` | `number` | `14` | Max zoom at which points are clustered. |
| `clusterRadius` | `number` | `50` | Cluster radius in pixels. |
| `clusterColors` | `[string, string, string]` | `['#22c55e', '#eab308', '#ef4444']` | Circle colors for small/medium/large clusters. ng-mapcn defaults to green/yellow/red; mapcn uses ['#3b82f6', '#1d4ed8', '#1e3a8a']. |
| `clusterThresholds` | `[number, number]` | `[100, 750]` | Point-count thresholds between color tiers. |
| `pointColor` | `string` | `'#3b82f6'` | Color of unclustered points. |
| `zoomOnClusterClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Zooms into a cluster when it is clicked. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pointClick` | `ClusterPointClickEvent<P>` | — | Emits { feature, coordinates } when an unclustered point is clicked. |
| `clusterClick` | `ClusterClickEvent` | — | Emits { clusterId, coordinates, pointCount } when a cluster is clicked. |

### MapHeatmap

`ng-map-heatmap`

Renders GeoJSON points as a MapLibre heatmap layer with a theme-aware default gradient. Generic over the feature properties: MapHeatmapComponent<P>, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `string \| FeatureCollection<Point, P>` | `required` | GeoJSON points (object or URL string). |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id prefix for the source and layer: heatmap-source-<id>, heatmap-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates them. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `weightProperty` | `string` | — | Numeric feature property used as the point weight. Without it every point weighs the same. |
| `weightRange` | `[number, number]` | `[0, 1]` | [min, max] of weightProperty, mapped linearly to a weight of 0..1. |
| `radius` | `number \| expression` | `30` | Influence radius of each point in pixels. Accepts MapLibre expressions. |
| `intensity` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Global intensity multiplier. Accepts MapLibre expressions. |
| `opacity` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Layer opacity. Accepts MapLibre expressions. |
| `gradient` | `HeatmapGradient` | `theme default` | Color stops [density 0..1, color]. Sorted, with a transparent stop at 0 prepended when missing. Defaults to defaultHeatmapGradients for the resolved theme. |
| `minZoom` | `number` | `0` | Minimum zoom at which the heatmap is rendered. |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | `24` | Zoom from which the heatmap is no longer rendered (e.g. to hand over to a point layer). |
| `paint` | `HeatmapLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: heatmap paint properties merged last. |

### MapSymbolLayer

`ng-map-symbol-layer`

Icons and text labels for GeoJSON points as a MapLibre symbol layer (collision-aware). Images are registered from a URL or decoded pixels, shared by id between layers and survive theme switches; SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer. Generic over the feature properties: MapSymbolLayerComponent<P>, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `string \| FeatureCollection<Point, P> \| Feature<Point, P>` | `required` | GeoJSON points (object or URL string). |
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Optional stable id prefix for the source and layer: symbol-source-<id>, symbol-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates them. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `images` | `Record<string, MapSymbolImage>` | `{}` | Images to register by id, referenced from icon. A MapSymbolImage is a URL (PNG, WebP or JPEG), { url, sdf?, pixelRatio? } or { data, sdf?, pixelRatio? } with decoded pixels. URLs are decoded once and re-added after a theme switch. Ids are shared per map: layers registering the same id use one image (the first to add it provides the pixels, so give different images different ids), removed when the last layer using it goes away; an id the style already has is never removed. SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer; use one layer per kind. |
| `icon` | `string \| expression` | — | Image id, or an expression resolving to one (["get", "kind"]). |
| `iconSize` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Icon scale. |
| `iconColor` | `string \| expression` | — | Icon color. Only applies to SDF images ({ url, sdf: true }). SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer; use one layer per kind. |
| `textField` | `string \| expression` | — | Label text: a {property} template, a plain string or an expression. Needs the style glyphs; ignored (with a console warning) on the blank style. |
| `textFont` | `string[]` | `basemap's font` | Font stack for the labels. Defaults to the basemap's own, which its glyph server serves. |
| `textSize` | `number \| expression` | `12` | Label size in pixels. |
| `textColor` | `string \| expression` | `theme default` | Label color (#171717 light, #fafafa dark). |
| `textHaloColor` | `string \| expression` | `theme default` | Label halo color (#ffffff light, #0a0a0a dark). |
| `textHaloWidth` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Label halo width in pixels. |
| `textAnchor` | `string` | `top with icon, else center` | Which part of the label touches the anchor. |
| `textOffset` | `[number, number]` | `[0, 0.8] with icon, else [0, 0]` | Label offset in ems. |
| `allowOverlap` | `boolean` | `false` | Draw icons and labels even when they collide (sets icon-allow-overlap and text-allow-overlap). |
| `minZoom` | `number` | `0` | Minimum zoom at which the layer is rendered. |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | `24` | Zoom from which the layer is no longer rendered. |
| `filter` | `FilterSpecification` | — | MapLibre filter expression, reconciled live. |
| `layout` | `SymbolLayerSpecification["layout"]` | — | Escape hatch: layout properties merged last. |
| `paint` | `SymbolLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: paint properties merged last. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether features respond to mouse events. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `featureClick` | `MapGeoJSONEvent<P>` | — | Emits { feature, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } when a symbol is clicked. Requires interactive. |
| `featureHover` | `MapGeoJSONEvent<P> \| null` | — | Emits the hovered symbol (again when the pointer moves to another one), and null when the pointer leaves. Requires interactive. Inline data without feature ids gets ids generated from the feature index (generateId); data with ids keeps them. |

### MapRasterSource

`ng-map-raster-source`

Raster tile source (XYZ, TMS, WMS) plus the raster layer that draws it. Source and layer are re-added after a theme switch. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | MapLibre source id, used verbatim (other components reference it as source: id). The layer is raster-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates both. |
| `tiles` | `string[]` | — | Tile URL templates ({z}/{x}/{y}, {bbox-epsg-3857} for WMS). Updated in place with setTiles. |
| `url` | `string` | — | TileJSON URL, instead of tiles (takes precedence). Updated in place with setUrl. |
| `tileSize` | `number` | `256` | Tile size in pixels. Applied at creation. |
| `minzoom` | `number` | `0` | Minimum tile zoom. Applied at creation. |
| `maxzoom` | `number` | `22` | Maximum tile zoom. Applied at creation. |
| `attribution` | `string` | — | Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation. |
| `bounds` | `[number, number, number, number]` | — | [west, south, east, north] limit of the tiles. Applied at creation. |
| `scheme` | `'xyz' \| 'tms'` | `'xyz'` | Tile addressing scheme. Applied at creation. |
| `opacity` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Raster layer opacity (raster-opacity). |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the layer is drawn; the source stays loaded when hidden. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `paint` | `RasterLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: raster paint properties merged last. |

### MapVectorSource

`ng-map-vector-source`

Vector tile source (MVT, TileJSON or pmtiles://). Adds the source only: draw it with layers that reference it by id and wait for it with MapContextService.hasSource(id). ng-mapcn does not depend on pmtiles; register the protocol yourself with maplibregl.addProtocol. When torn down or the style reloads it removes every layer still using the source, then the source: gate your layers on hasSource(id). tiles vs url mode is fixed at creation. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | MapLibre source id, used verbatim; layers reference it as source: id. Announced through MapContextService.hasSource(id) while it exists. Changing it re-creates the source. |
| `tiles` | `string[]` | — | Tile URL templates. Updated in place with setTiles. |
| `url` | `string` | — | TileJSON URL or pmtiles://<archive url> (register the pmtiles protocol first), instead of tiles. Updated in place with setUrl. |
| `minzoom` | `number` | `0` | Minimum tile zoom. Applied at creation. |
| `maxzoom` | `number` | `22` | Maximum tile zoom. Applied at creation. |
| `attribution` | `string` | — | Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation. |
| `bounds` | `[number, number, number, number]` | — | [west, south, east, north] limit of the tiles. Applied at creation. |
| `scheme` | `'xyz' \| 'tms'` | `'xyz'` | Tile addressing scheme. Applied at creation. |
| `promoteId` | `string \| Record<string, string>` | — | Feature property (or per source-layer map) used as the feature id, which enables feature-state on vector tiles. Applied at creation. |

### MapImageOverlay

`ng-map-image-overlay`

Georeferenced image pinned to four corner coordinates, drawn as a raster layer. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | MapLibre image source id, used verbatim. The layer is image-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates both. |
| `url` | `string` | `required` | Image URL. Changing it calls updateImage on the live source. |
| `coordinates` | `ImageOverlayCoordinates` | `required` | Four [lng, lat] corners, clockwise from the top-left. Changing them calls setCoordinates. |
| `opacity` | `number \| expression` | `1` | Layer opacity (raster-opacity). |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the layer is drawn. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `paint` | `RasterLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: raster paint properties merged last (e.g. raster-fade-duration: 0 to avoid a flash on url change). |

### MapFillExtrusion

`ng-map-fill-extrusion`

3D extrusion of polygons (fill-extrusion layer), e.g. 3D buildings. Creates only the layer: the source is a basemap source or one added by a source component or the application, and the layer waits for it. Re-added after a theme switch. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Layer id prefix; the layer is fill-extrusion-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates the layer. |
| `source` | `string` | `Carto basemap source` | Id of the source to extrude: a tile source component, an application source or a basemap source. Without it, the Carto basemap's building source is used ('protomaps', or 'carto' in the earlier styles). The layer is added once map.getSource(source) exists. |
| `sourceLayer` | `string` | `'buildings' for 'protomaps', 'building' for 'carto', else none` | Layer of a vector source. Omit for GeoJSON sources. |
| `heightProperty` | `string` | `'height' for 'protomaps', else 'render_height'` | Feature property with the height in meters. |
| `baseProperty` | `string` | `'min_height' for 'protomaps', else 'render_min_height'` | Feature property with the base height in meters. |
| `color` | `string \| expression` | `theme gray` | Fill color; defaults to a theme-aware gray (defaultExtrusionColors). |
| `opacity` | `number` | `0.8` | Layer opacity, 0..1. |
| `minZoom` | `number` | `14` | Minimum zoom at which the extrusion is drawn (the Carto tiles stop at 14). |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | `24` | Zoom from which the extrusion is no longer drawn. |
| `filter` | `FilterSpecification \| null` | `['!=', ['get', 'hide_3d'], true]` | MapLibre filter, updated with setFilter. null removes the default filter. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only. |
| `paint` | `FillExtrusionLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: fill-extrusion paint properties merged last. |

### MapTerrain

`ng-map-terrain`

3D terrain from a raster-dem source (map.setTerrain) with an optional hillshade layer. The terrain is style-level state: it is re-applied after a theme switch and disabled on teardown. One terrain per map. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | `auto` | Id prefix: DEM source terrain-source-<id>, hillshade source terrain-hillshade-source-<id>, hillshade layer terrain-hillshade-<id>. Changing it re-creates all. |
| `tiles` | `string[]` | `public Terrarium tiles` | Elevation tile URL templates. Applied at creation. |
| `url` | `string` | — | TileJSON URL, instead of tiles (takes precedence). Applied at creation. |
| `encoding` | `'terrarium' \| 'mapbox'` | `'terrarium'` | Encoding of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation. |
| `tileSize` | `number` | `256` | Tile size in pixels. Applied at creation. |
| `minzoom` | `number` | — | Minimum zoom of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation. |
| `maxzoom` | `number` | `15 for the default tiles` | Maximum zoom of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation. |
| `attribution` | `string` | `Mapzen / AWS for the default tiles` | Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation. |
| `exaggeration` | `number` | `1` | How tall the terrain looks. Changing it calls setTerrain again. |
| `hillshade` | `boolean` | `false` | Draw a hillshade layer (with its own DEM source). Added and removed on toggle; the terrain is untouched. |
| `hillshadeExaggeration` | `number` | — | Hillshade intensity, 0..1 (MapLibre default 0.5). |
| `hillshadeShadowColor` | `string` | — | Hillshade color of the shaded slopes. |
| `hillshadeHighlightColor` | `string` | — | Hillshade color of the lit slopes. |
| `hillshadeAccentColor` | `string` | — | Hillshade accent color for steep slopes. |
| `hillshadePaint` | `HillshadeLayerSpecification["paint"]` | — | Escape hatch: hillshade paint properties merged last. |
| `beforeId` | `string` | — | Insert the hillshade layer before this layer id. Applied when the layer is created only. |

### MapDraw

`ng-map-draw`

Draws, selects and edits points, lines and polygons on terra-draw. Lives in the optional ng-mapcn/draw entry point (import { MapDrawComponent } from 'ng-mapcn/draw') and needs the terra-draw and terra-draw-maplibre-gl-adapter peer dependencies. A theme switch (setStyle) stops and restarts terra-draw with the same features and mode. Must be used inside ng-map.

**Inputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `modes` | `('point' \| 'line' \| 'polygon')[]` | `all three` | Shapes the user can draw. Changing it restarts terra-draw with the same features and drops an unfinished shape. |
| `mode` | `'point' \| 'line' \| 'polygon' \| 'select' \| 'static'` | `'static'` | Active tool (two-way with [(mode)]). A mode that is not enabled falls back to 'static'. |
| `features` | `FeatureCollection` | `empty` | Drawn features as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Point, LineString and Polygon (two-way with [(features)]). Updates when a draw, edit or delete completes. Assigning a collection diffs by feature id; features keep their own ids (any non-empty string or finite number) and those without one get an id; unsupported geometries are dropped and reported through mapError. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables the select mode: select, drag, reshape and delete features. Changing it restarts terra-draw and drops an unfinished shape. |
| `color` | ``#${string}`` | `theme default` | Accent color of the drawn shapes (#rrggbb). Defaults to a theme-aware blue. Changing it restyles the modes in place (no restart). |

**Outputs**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drawEnd` | `MapDrawEvent` | — | Emits { feature, mode, action } when a new shape is completed. |
| `featureEdit` | `MapDrawEvent` | — | Emits { feature, mode, action } when an existing feature is moved, reshaped or otherwise edited. |
| `featureSelect` | `MapDrawFeature` | — | Emits the selected Feature (select mode). |
| `featureDeselect` | `string \| number` | — | Emits the id of the deselected feature. |

## MapContextService

Component-scoped service provided by `ng-map` — the Angular equivalent of mapcn's `useMap()` hook. Inject it in any component projected inside `ng-map` to reach the raw map.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `map()` | `Signal<Map \| null>` | — | The raw maplibre-gl Map instance, or null before init. |
| `isLoaded()` | `Signal<boolean>` | — | True when the style is loaded and layers can be added. Gates every source/layer operation; closes during a theme/basemap switch and re-opens once it settles (or fails). |
| `resolvedTheme()` | `Signal<'light' \| 'dark'>` | — | Theme currently applied to the map. |
| `hasSource(id)` | `(id: string) => boolean` | — | Whether a source component (raster, vector, image overlay) currently has a source with this id on the map. Reactive inside effect(); false while a theme switch has removed the style. Wait on it before adding layers that reference source: id. |
| `sourceIds()` | `Signal<ReadonlySet<string>>` | — | Ids of the sources currently announced by source components. |
| `registerSource(id)` | `(id: string) => () => void` | — | Announces a source you added yourself so hasSource(id) sees it; returns the release function to call when you remove it. |
| `fitBounds(options?)` | `(options?: MapFitBoundsOptions) => boolean` | — | Fits the camera to options.bounds, or to the union of the children's data. Returns false when the map is not loaded or there are no bounds. |
| `dataBounds()` | `Signal<[number, number, number, number] \| null>` | — | Union of the bounds registered by the children, as [west, south, east, north]. |
| `acquireImage(id, data, options)` | `(id: string, data, options: { sdf: boolean; pixelRatio: number }) => () => void` | — | Takes a reference to a style image, adding it when the style has none under that id (the first user provides the pixels). Returns the release function: the image is removed with its last reference, and only if it is still the one added here. Release while the gate is closed and acquire again once it re-opens. Used by ng-map-symbol-layer. |
| `registerBounds(getter)` | `(getter: () => LngLatBoundsLike \| null) => () => void` | — | Contributes a bounds source to fit-to-bounds. The getter runs reactively; returns the unregister function (call it on destroy). |

## provideMapStyles()

Sets the app-wide default basemap through the `MAP_DEFAULT_STYLES` token. Every `ng-map` without its own `styles` input (and without `blank`) uses it; pass a signal to swap the basemap at runtime.

```ts
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { provideMapStyles } from 'ng-mapcn';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    // Static config...
    provideMapStyles({
      light: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron',
      dark: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark',
    }),

    // ...or a signal, so the basemap can be switched at runtime
    provideMapStyles(() => inject(BasemapService).styles),
  ],
};
```

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MapStylesConfig` | `{ light?: string \| StyleSpecification; dark?: string \| StyleSpecification }` | — | Per-theme basemap. A theme left undefined falls back to the Carto default for that theme. |
| `provideMapStyles(source)` | `MapStylesConfig \| Signal<MapStylesConfig \| undefined> \| (() => Signal<MapStylesConfig \| undefined>)` | — | Provider for the app-wide basemap. The factory form runs in an injection context, so it can inject() a service holding the signal. |
| `MAP_DEFAULT_STYLES` | `InjectionToken<Signal<MapStylesConfig \| undefined>>` | — | The token itself, if you want to provide it by hand. |

## provideMapLabels()

Translates the control buttons, the loader and the popup close button through the `MAP_LABELS` token. Partial labels merge over the English defaults; pass a signal to follow the active locale. A `labels` input on `ng-map`, `ng-map-controls` and `ng-map-popup` overrides it per component.

```ts
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { provideMapLabels } from 'ng-mapcn';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    // Static (partial) labels merge over the English defaults...
    provideMapLabels({
      zoomIn: 'Aproximar',
      zoomOut: 'Afastar',
      resetNorth: 'Apontar para o norte',
      locate: 'Minha localização',
      fullscreen: 'Tela cheia',
      loading: 'Carregando mapa',
      closePopup: 'Fechar',
    }),

    // ...or a signal, so the labels follow the active locale
    provideMapLabels(() => inject(I18nService).mapLabels),
  ],
};

// Per component: <ng-map-controls [labels]="{ zoomIn: 'Acercar' }" />
```

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MapLabels` | `{ zoomIn; zoomOut; resetNorth; locate; fullscreen; loading; closePopup; marker; scale; legend; showLegend; hideLegend; mapStyle: string }` | — | Every user-facing and aria string the library renders. Defaults are English: 'Zoom in', 'Zoom out', 'Reset north', 'My location', 'Toggle fullscreen', 'Loading map', 'Close popup', 'Map marker', 'Map scale', 'Map legend', 'Show legend', 'Hide legend', 'Map style'. |
| `provideMapLabels(source)` | `Partial<MapLabels> \| Signal<Partial<MapLabels> \| undefined> \| (() => Signal<Partial<MapLabels> \| undefined>)` | — | Provider for app-wide labels; missing keys fall back to the English defaults. The factory form runs in an injection context, so it can inject() a service holding the signal. |
| `MAP_LABELS` | `InjectionToken<Signal<Partial<MapLabels> \| undefined>>` | — | The token itself, if you want to provide it by hand. |
| `DEFAULT_MAP_LABELS` | `MapLabels` | — | The English defaults. |

## Basemaps

Any MapLibre-compatible style works. Set it per map with the `styles` input, or app-wide with `provideMapStyles()`. Precedence: `[styles]` → `[blank]` → `provideMapStyles()` → Carto default.

| Provider | Style URL | API key |
|---|---|---|
| Carto (default) | `https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/{positron|dark-matter|voyager}-gl-style/style.json` | no |
| OpenFreeMap | `https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/{liberty|bright|positron|dark|fiord}` | no |
| OpenStreetMap | raster tiles `https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` — build the StyleSpecification by hand; dev/demo only (tile usage policy) | no |
| MapTiler | `https://api.maptiler.com/maps/{streets-v4|streets-v4-dark|dataviz-v4}/style.json?key=KEY` | yes |
| Stadia Maps | `https://tiles.stadiamaps.com/styles/{alidade_smooth|alidade_smooth_dark}.json?api_key=KEY` | keyless on localhost |

## Theming

Without a `theme` input, the map watches the `dark`/`light` class on `document.documentElement` (works with any theme toggler) and falls back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Switching theme calls `map.setStyle(..., { diff: true })`; every layer component re-adds itself automatically once the style settles.

## SSR

The map is created in `afterNextRender` (browser-only, after hydration) and every child component gates its work on the map signal, which is `null` on the server. On the server the host renders a plain container `<div>` plus the loader, which matches the first client render and hydrates cleanly. Enable `provideClientHydration(withEventReplay())` in the consumer app.

## Invariants (when editing the library sources)

1. Every source/layer operation is gated on `MapContextService.isLoaded()` (map `load` + debounced `styledata`). A theme or basemap switch calls `setStyle`, which destroys layers — the gate closes and reopens, and each layer component's creation `effect` re-adds everything.
2. MapLibre objects are created **once** and reconciled with diffed setters; never destroyed/recreated on input changes.
3. Controlled viewport uses an internal flag around `jumpTo` plus a `map.isMoving()` skip to avoid feedback loops.
4. Teardown is defensive (try/catch): remove layers before the source; symmetric `map.off` for every `map.on(event, layerId, handler)`.
5. Declarative hover = `promoteId` + `setFeatureState` + `mergeHoverPaint` (case expressions on `feature-state hover`).
6. Arcs render an invisible hit layer with `width = max(line-width + 6, 12)` under the visible layer.

## Key Features

- **MapLibre GL JS v6** under the hood — no API keys required (Carto basemaps)
- **Composable** — markers, popups, routes, GeoJSON, arcs, clusters, heatmaps, symbol labels, tile sources, image overlays, 3D buildings and terrain are children of `<ng-map>`
- **Signals-first** — standalone components, `input()`/`output()`, `effect()`-based reconciliation, OnPush
- **Theme-aware** — swaps the basemap at runtime, layers survive the style change
- **SSR-safe** — the map is created in `afterNextRender`; nothing touches `document` on the server
- **Copy-paste distribution** — `ng add ng-mapcn` copies the sources into your project (shadcn-style)

## Tech Stack

- Angular 22+ (standalone, signals, zoneless-friendly)
- TypeScript
- MapLibre GL JS v6
- TailwindCSS (demo site)
- Carto basemaps (default tiles)
